notes.title: Maid Cafe Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the official release date for upcoming adult game Maid Cafe... You can look forward to playing the game in full on the 25th August 2023. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/3fe6184f9887899da32c04fb0feb4f501d8f5dc5.png

Make sure you wishlist the game now to be notified on release, so that you can enjoy the biggest game we have published. Maid Games have done an amazing job with the development of this game.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/28b5f5aa9e28f131d54905c498d548df9af977b9.png

It features almost half a million words of dialogue and scripting, over 35 characters to meet and have sexy fun with, plus over 1000 adult illustrations to unlock and enjoy, plus the chance to explore the town, buy items from shops, visit local destinations, go on dates, practice your desserts, learn new recipes and compete in a bake off competition!

Wishlist it now and don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423640/Maid_Cafe/

Deluxe Bundles and Discounts available on release, the game also comes with trading cards and Achievements to unlock.

notes.title: Galaxy Girls Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce our latest game development, Galaxy Girls, releases today on Steam, utilising the same artist as the Negligee game following a new quartet of women in space...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/560250/Galaxy_Girls/

Checkout the store page now, as on the week of release there will be a number of discounts and bonus sets available for buyers to take advantage of including discounts on the main game, Day 1 DLC and our season pass. As well as our Deluxe edition Bundle with further discount available.

In honour of the release Negligee and it's DLC will also be getting a special week long promotion.

notes.title: Magi Trials Game Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that our next major game release is happening right now, Highschool Romance: Magi Trials a detailed fun visual novel is now available on Steam. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/446600/

Take a look now to get extra discount on its release and enjoy an even bigger and more interesting game that our original Highschool Romance title, with an amazing script, multiple endings and over 100 illustrations. A new story created by the same team who created the game Highschool Romance.

Plus more, check it out today to try your hand at our new Magical Title.
